policy: Every functional phase must execute all critical checks and all checks belonging to the changed dependency scope.

checks.check: Login, session restoration, logout and forced password change remain functional.
Displayed screen, active menu, title, route identity and sub-tab remain aligned.
Appointments, reference data, vehicles, reports, KPIs, payments and history open and re-open.
Dashboard and every Smart Reports tab render data on cold and warm cache.
Filters, tax modes, show-more, details, sorting and customer actions each have one owner and update the DOM.
Sales invoice report loads, renders, opens, prints and re-opens without readiness errors.
Customer 360 opens from every source and returns to the originating screen.
Screen rows, filtered rows, KPIs and exports use the same committed revision.
Entry, import, records, invoice actions and duplicate policy remain functional.
Commission system and statement open; lock/snapshot behavior remains valid.
Payroll workflow, calculations, deletion restrictions and exports remain valid.
Filters and export parity, manual deletion and invoice movement protection.
Inventory reports never claim matched without an actual count source.
Filter/export parity, soft delete, restore and permanent-delete authorization.
Save, apply, reset, reload and auto-refresh use the same canonical user key.
Arabic/English parity, runtime fallback and first-paint labels remain valid.
Buttons, labels, filters and tables remain readable on desktop/mobile and dark/light.
Service worker, cache tokens, cold cache, warm cache and offline critical shell remain aligned.
RLS-dependent operations, OTP, sessions, audit and trusted devices remain valid.
No uncaught errors, readiness failures or duplicate provider registrations.
